# Property Systems Lab

> Automation and operations support for property management and vacation rental companies.

Property Systems Lab helps property management and vacation rental businesses reduce manual admin work, streamline operations, and scale efficiently using AI workflows, automation, CRM optimization, and trained virtual assistant support.

## Who We Serve

- Long-term rental (LTR) property management companies
- Vacation rental (STR/VR) operators and managers
- Mixed-portfolio property management teams
- Growing property management businesses looking to scale without adding headcount

## What We Do

- **Automation & AI Systems**: We build trigger-based workflows that eliminate repetitive manual steps — lead follow-up sequences, maintenance notifications, owner update automations, and system integrations using Zapier and n8n.
- **CRM & Pipeline Optimization**: We set up and clean up sales, leasing, owner acquisition, and maintenance pipelines so teams always know what needs attention. Primary platform: HubSpot.
- **Virtual Assistant Support**: Trained operational support for tasks that still need human judgment — owner communications, inbox management, data entry, document tracking, and recurring admin tasks.
- **Reporting & Operations Dashboards**: Automated reports and summaries for maintenance status, owner performance, leasing activity, and team workload using Google Sheets.
- **Document & Communication Workflows**: Streamlined document preparation, follow-up sequences, and internal handoffs using PandaDoc and email/SMS automation.

## Platforms & Tools We Work With

Zapier, n8n, HubSpot, Hostaway, Propertyware, PandaDoc, Google Sheets, and custom API integrations.

## Pricing

- Workflow Audit: Starting at $750 (one-time)
- Automation Implementation: Starting at $3,500 (one-time)
- Automation + VA Operations Support: Starting at $2,500/month (most popular)
- Monthly Automation Support: Starting at $1,250/month
- Custom Operations Support: Custom quote
